# Portable package examples

These version-1 JSON examples are data only. `publishing.json` includes actual Markdown Help, a linear workflow and diagnostic defaults; `draft-lens.json` is an inactive-on-import style lens. The canonical validator and round-trip tests read both files. Their `aiContext` is intentionally concise inert authoring documentation; actual GUI exports supply the full detailed prompt.

Open them through the native Facets or lens import surface and preview before saving. They contain no vault paths, notes, credentials, enabled state, scripts or device preferences. Schema: [PORTABLE_PRESETS.md](../../../docs/PORTABLE_PRESETS.md). Authoring instructions: [FACETS_AUTHORING.md](../../../docs/FACETS_AUTHORING.md).
